event.bram_heart2.1.text: Watch the color. Cherry, not yellow. ...You watch the door more than the fire. Hm. Fire first.

event.bram_heart5.2.text: Here. Two bars. Look after them. Hm. And yourself. Iron keeps score. So do I.
event.bram_heart5.2.why: same handover, care extended to the player

event.next_door.2.why: the six-notes knowing shows obliquely, per r2 ruling

event.hall_dance.7.text: Hm. Hm-hm. ...Hm. Lost it. The room hums louder than me.

event.hall_dance.7.text: Hm. Hm-hm. Hm. Edmund hummed one like it. Four notes. Never learned the fourth.

event.story_whistler_bram.intro.why: unaware man doubting his own ears at dusk

event.story_whistler_bram.intro.text: {pause=0.5}...Hm. How long have you been standing there? Quiet feet. Quiet night. Too much of both.

event.bram_heart4.after.text: It'll hold. Hm. You look like the hammer caught you. Sit. Forge is warm. No charge for the chair.
event.bram_heart4.after.why: Juno joke yields to tending a frightened player

event.bram_heart6.intro.text: Hm. Sit. Not on the bucket. You look worn through. Good. Company, then. This'll be long. For me.
event.bram_heart6.intro.why: frightened player folded into the confession, warmth intact

event.bram_heart8.after.text: I'll tell her today. Not near today. Today. Words shouldn't wait on better light.
event.bram_heart8.after.why: strain brings urgency; repetition as mild distortion

event.bram_heart8.after.text: I'll tell her. Today. Hm. Dark comes early lately. Words shouldn't wait.
event.bram_heart8.after.why: same resolve, early-dark noticing, no imagery

event.bram_heart10.give.text: Gold. Soft. Won't rust. Won't fail you. For you. Hm.
event.bram_heart10.give.why: his fear of a tool failing someone, turned gentle

event.bram_friend.doing.text: Bread's yours. Cheese is mine. Hm. The quiet's heavier these days. We'll split that too.
event.bram_friend.doing.why: the shared silence gains weight, warmth intact

event.bram_birthday.intro.text: Birthday. No fuss. Juno made a card, mostly diagrams. No other mail. Village will empty early tonight. It always does, on the fourth.
event.bram_birthday.intro.why: hint: his birthday is Fall 4, a date the village keeps; letters ache kept

event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l1.why: nail-order hint from the bible; Marcus's count still answers it

event.overheard_wren_bram_3.l2.why: dread makes him honest; exactly four words so Wren's count lands

adds.why: hint echoing his 'good steel sings' line, never explained

adds.text: Hm. You're not right today. Sit. The forge doesn't ask questions.
adds.why: fills the cut teacher aside; plain human comfort

notes: next_door.2 clue carries the six-notes knowing obliquely per the r2 ruling; it holds no horror content, so it reads as pure warmth at mild — flag if a different gate is wanted.
dlg.bram.repair.0 clue invents how Edmund's hoe reached the forge (left at the door, no note, the week before he died); new canon, consistent with the r2 starter-tool ruling — Director to bless.
bram_birthday is repeatable, so its fourth-of-the-season hint recurs yearly; intended, since Fall 4 is a ritual date and Bram never explains it.
overheard_bram_marcus_3 hint plays against Marcus; his unchanged reply now doubles as a Keeper's deflection — no change needed his side, but he should know.
Untouched for contrast: overheard_juno_bram 1-4, bram_marcus 1-2, wren_bram 1-2, tilda_bram 1; wren_1's closing 'Hm.' stays locked per r2.
